infoLinks.content:
At Moore Park Light Rail Lift between Moore Park and the footbridge is temporarily out of service.
 
The lifts are out of service until further notice while replacement works are carried out.
 
During this period, use the accessible entry/exit pathway via the crossing at the intersection of Anzac Parade and Lang Road, or via the Entertainment Quarter side, or use the stairs at this stop if you are able to do so safely.
 
Please allow extra travel time and plan ahead, using the Trip Planner and checking travel alerts to see if your travel is affected.
